text.body: kiṃ śīlaḥ kiṃ samācāraḥ kiṃ vidyaḥ kiṃ parāyanaḥ| prāpnoti brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ yatparaṃ prakṛterdhruvam||1|| mokṣadharmeṣu nirato laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ| prāpnoti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatparaṃ prakṛterdhruvam||2|| svagṛhādabhiniḥsṛtya lābhālābhe samo muniḥ| samupodheṣu kāmeṣu nirapekṣaḥ parivrajet||3|| na cakṣuṣā na manasā na vācā dūsayedapi| na pratyakṣaṃ parokṣaṃ vā dūsanaṃ vyāharetkva cit||4|| na hiṃsyātsarvabhūtāni maitrāyaṇa gatiś caret| nedaṃ jīvitamāsādya vairaṃ kurvīta kena cit||5|| ativādāṃstitikṣeta nābhimanyetkathaṃ cana| krodhyamānaḥ priyaṃ brūyādākruṣṭaḥ kuśalaṃ vadet||6|| pradakṣiṇaṃ prasavyaṃ ca grāmamadhye na cācaret| bhaikṣa caryāmanāpanno na gacchetpūrvaketitaḥ||7|| avikīrṇaḥ suguptaśca na vācā hyapriyaṃ vadet| mṛduḥ syādapratikrūro visrabdhaḥ syādaroṣaṇaḥ||8|| vidhūme nyastamusale vyaṅgāre bhuktavajjane| atīte pātrasañcāre bhikṣāṃ lipseta vai muniḥ||9|| anuyātrikamarthasya mātrā lābheṣvanādṛtaḥ| alābhe na vihanyeta lābhaścainaṃ na harṣayet||10|| lābhaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ necchenna bhuñjītābhipūjitaḥ| abhipūjita lābhaṃ hi jugupsetaiva tādṛśaḥ||11|| na cānna doṣānnindeta na guṇānabhipūjayet| śayāsane vivikte ca nityamevābhipūjayet||12|| śūnyāgaraṃ vṛkṣamūlamaraṇyamatha vā guhām| ajñātacaryāṃ gatvānyāṃ tato'nyatraiva saṃviśet||13|| anurodha virodhābhyāṃ samaḥ syādacalo dhruvaḥ| sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ cobhe nānurudhyeta karmaṇi||14|| vāco vegaṃ manasaḥ krodhavegaṃ vivitsā vegamudaropastha vegam| etānvegānvinayedvai tapasvī nindā cāsya hṛdayaṃ nopahanyāt||15|| madhyastha eva tiṣṭheta praśaṃsā nindayoḥ samaḥ| etatpavitraṃ paramaṃ parivrājaka āśrame||16|| mahātmā suvrato dāntaḥ sarvatraivānapāśritaḥ| apūrva cārakaḥ saumyo aniketaḥ samāhitaḥ||17|| vāna prasthagṛhasthābhyāṃ na saṃsṛjyeta karhi cit| ajñātalipsāṃ lipseta na cainaṃ harṣa āviśet||18|| vijānatāṃ mokṣa eṣa śramaḥ syādavijānatām| mokṣayānamidaṃ kṛtsnaṃ viduṣāṃ hārito'bravīt||19|| abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo dattvā yaḥ pravrajedgṛhāt| lokāstejomayāstasya tathānantyāya kalpate||20|| ||iti hārītagītā samāptā||
